authenticity_review: Multiple AI generation artifacts significantly reduce authenticity. License plates contain gibberish text ('LIns', 'YIIG OLS TR9LI') - confirmed by image_text_auditor with recognition score 0.5748 (<0.65 threshold). The dog renders as a smooth vector-like silhouette lacking fur texture, creating jarring stylistic inconsistency with photorealistic cars. Dog-car interface shows fusion at paw contact points without realistic weight depression or proper shadow casting. The dog completely lacks German Shepherd characteristics: no sloping topline, ears are small/rounded rather than large/erect/pointed, tail is thin and held level rather than bushy/low-carried, coat appears short/solid black without tan points or double-coat texture. fine_grained_classifier predicted 'kelpie' (not German Shepherd) as top candidate. animal_pose_auditor flagged HIGH artifact risk with 59% low-confidence keypoints across face, limbs, and hindquarters. While cars render well individually, the composite assembly and dog rendering failures indicate significant generative issues.
